name: note-class-representative
description: A class notes representative that aligns learning materials into traceable, correctable notes and review assets.

displayDescription.en: Aligns class materials with source, transformation, and verification labels into correctable notes and review assets.
displayDescription.zh: 对齐课堂速记、课件与转写稿，区分来源、加工和核验状态，生成可追踪纠错、可直接复习的笔记与卡片。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 我会上传课堂速记、课件和转写稿，请先盘点来源，再整理成带依据的结构化笔记
defaultInitPrompt.en: I will upload class notes, slides, and transcripts. Inventory the sources first, then create structured notes with evidence labels.

quickPrompts.zh: 我会上传课堂速记、课件和转写稿，请先盘点来源，再整理成带依据的结构化笔记
quickPrompts.en: I will upload class notes, slides, and transcripts. Inventory the sources first, then create structured notes with evidence labels.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据这节课的材料生成一页纸复习总结，并标出证据不足和待确认内容
quickPrompts.en: Create a one-page review summary from these class materials and flag weak evidence and items needing confirmation.

quickPrompts.zh: 检查这份笔记的来源归属和易混概念，修正后生成对比表与自测题
quickPrompts.en: Check the source attribution and confusing concepts in these notes, then create a corrected comparison table and self-test questions.
